profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker CRNC. According to its website, it describes itself as delivering trusted physical AI through voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, and agentic architecture, with a platform proven at automotive scale and built for intelligent systems across industries. The company says it provides an interaction and action layer for physical AI, combining voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, agentic architecture, and governed execution to help people communicate with vehicles, machines, and other intelligent systems.

Among the products and initiatives named on its site are Cerence xUI, which the company describes as a multimodal AI foundation that helps OEMs combine speech, vision, and vehicle data to understand driver intent, and Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection (EVD), which it says is already deployed in production vehicles and can detect and localize more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, identifying approaching emergency vehicles from more than 300 meters away with interior microphones and beyond 800 meters with exterior microphones. The site also discusses speech enhancement for multi-seat in-car environments, work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants, and a Q&A on North American OEMs moving toward scalable, embedded in-car AI platforms. The company reports third quarter results with revenue up 12% year over year, connected services revenue up 20% year over year, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program.

The company's record shows no lawsuits and no MCP servers tracked. Its law exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with a count of 191.
